Job Summary

The opportunity: Consultant-TMT-Business Consulting PI-CNS - BC - Finance - Gurgaon
TMT :
Industry convergence offers TMT (Technology, Media Entertainment, and Telecommunications) organizations the chance to evolve and transform, but it also presents challenges around competitiveness and delivering agile corporate strategies for growth. Content distributors are transforming into content producers, service providers are becoming tech companies, technology companies are the catalyst for dramatic change in every sector, and customers want the latest innovations now.
We help TMT companies create compelling employee and customer experiences, retaining skills and talent while achieving enterprise-wide operational excellence. We help them protect their data, brand and reputation. We also enable the pursuit of MA strategies that systematically create value, reduce risk and transform TMT companies into powerhouses that will lead the technology revolution of the future - building a better working world for all.


Responsibilities

Strong hands-on experience in applied AI and GenAI solution development, with a focus on RAG-based architectures. Proficient in building and orchestrating LLM workflows using LangChain for scalable business use cases. Exposure to agentic and graph-based application design using LangGraph to support complex reasoning flows. Ability to translate consulting requirements into technically sound AI solutions aligned to finance and business consulting contexts. Experience working with prompt-driven and retrieval-augmented systems to improve relevance, accuracy, and enterprise readiness.


Qualifications

Bachelor of Technology in Computer Science
Experience
DevOps Engineering (3+ years)


What we look for

People with the ability to work in a collaborative manner to provide services across multiple client departments while following the commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions. We look for people who are agile, curious, mindful, and able to sustain positive energy, while being adaptable and creative in their approach.


Disclaimer: This job posting has been aggregated from external source. Role details, content, and availability are subject to change. Applicants are advised to confirm the latest information directly on the company website before applying.
